Title: AWS Developer - EAD or GC or USC ONLY 
 Location: Reston, VA 
 Duration: 6+ months 
 

 
 Job Description: 
 • In-depth knowledge and hands on development experience with Java, J2EE, Spring, Oracle, PL/SQL, Postgress, Rest API’s, Microservices 
 • Picking the right AWS services for the application, Leveraging AWS SDKs to interact with AWS services from the application, Set up the AWS SDK and developer credentials for Java, Python, and JavaScript. 
 • Writing code that optimizes performance of AWS services used by the application 
 • Use Web Identity Framework, ADFS, SAML and Amazon Cognito for user authentication. 
 • Code-level application security (IAM roles, credentials, encryption, etc.), Use AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) for service authentication. 
 • Integrate applications and data by using Amazon Step Functions, Amazon Container Service ECS, Amazon Kinesis, AWS Lambda, Amazon Simple Queue Service (Amazon SQS), Amazon Simple Notification Service (Amazon SNS), and Amazon Simple Workflow Service (Amazon SWF). 
 • Deploy applications by using AWS Elastic Beanstalk and AWS CloudFormation. 
 • Experience with developing and maintaining applications written for Amazon Step function, Amazon Lambda, Amazon RDS- Postgress, Amazon ECS, Amazon Simple Storage Service, Amazon DynamoDB, Amazon Simple Queue Service, Amazon Simple Notification Service, Amazon Simple Workflow Service, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, and AWS CloudFormation. 
 • Use Amazon ElastiCache and Amazon CloudFront to improve application scalability. 
 • Experience integrating Jenkins with the code pipeline and CI/CD with AWS 
 Requirements 
 Must have at least 8 years of hands-on Java/J2EE/Oracle development experience 
 Must have at least 1+ years of hands on AWS development experience 
 AWS Developer Certification is a must 
 AWS Dev Ops Certificate is desired 
 AWS Solution Architect Certification is desired 
 
 
 Navya 
 navyar@usmsystems(dot)com 
 703-953-1819 
 
 


 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id navyar (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-953-1819.
